# Load/Compute Results (on test data 2021-2024)

## Predictions

Load predictions:

```{r}
preds_linear <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee,
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "detrending/final/test_preds.csv"
  )) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = W:NE,
    names_to = "region",
    values_to = "pred_linear"
  ) |>
  rename(date = Date) |>
  separate(
    date, 
    into = c("year", "week"), 
    sep = 4, 
    remove = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    week = as.numeric(week),
    newyears = ymd(paste0(year,"-01-01")),
    date = newyears + weeks(week)
  ) |>
  arrange(region, date) |>
  select(
    region, 
    date,
    year, 
    week,
    pred_linear
  )

preds_linear_detrended <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee,
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "detrending/final/test_residuals.csv"
  )) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = W:NE,
    names_to = "region",
    values_to = "pred_detrended_linear"
  ) |>
  rename(date = Date) |>
  separate(
    date, 
    into = c("year", "week"), 
    sep = 4, 
    remove = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    week = as.numeric(week),
    newyears = ymd(paste0(year,"-01-01")),
    date = newyears + weeks(week)
  ) |>
  arrange(region, date) |>
  select(
    region, 
    date,
    year, 
    week,
    pred_detrended_linear
  )

preds_rf <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee,
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "predictions_2021_2024_RF/RF_preds_standard_2021_2024.csv"
  )) |>
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  rename(
    date = forecast_date,
    obs = observed,
    pred_rf = predicted,
    pred_detrended_rf = pred_detrended
  ) |>
  separate(
    date, 
    into = c("year", "week"), 
    sep = 4, 
    remove = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    week = as.numeric(week),
    newyears = ymd(paste0(year,"-01-01")),
    date = newyears + weeks(week),
    extreme = ifelse(abs(z_score) >= 1, T, F)
  ) |>
  arrange(region, horizon, date) |>
  select(
    region, 
    horizon,
    date, 
    year, 
    week,
    obs,
    obs_detrended, 
    pred_rf, 
    pred_detrended_rf,
    z_score,
    extreme
  )

preds_eesn <-
  read.csv(file = paste0(
    fp_cee, 
    fp_res_test_eesn,
    "final-preds-chosen-by-all-data.csv"
  )) |>
  rename(pred_detrended_eesn = pred) |>
  mutate(
    newyears = ymd(paste0(year,"-01-01")),
    date = newyears + weeks(week)
  ) |>
  filter(
    data != "training",
    year < 2025
  ) |>
  select(-data, -newyears) |>
  select(region, horizon, date, year, week, pred_detrended_eesn) |>
  arrange(region, horizon, date)
```

Join predictions: 

```{r}
preds <-
  full_join(
    preds_rf,
    preds_eesn,
    by = join_by(horizon, region, date, year, week)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    preds_linear, 
    by = join_by(region, date, year, week)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    preds_linear_detrended, 
    by = join_by(region, date, year, week)
  ) |>
  mutate(extreme = ifelse(extreme, "extreme", NA)) |>
  select(
    horizon,
    region,
    date,
    year,
    week,
    z_score,
    extreme,
    obs,
    obs_detrended,
    pred_linear,
    pred_rf,
    pred_detrended_linear,
    pred_detrended_rf,
    pred_detrended_eesn,
    everything()
  )
```

## RMSEs

Load RMSEs:

```{r}
rmses_persis <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee, 
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "persistence/final/rmse_results_persistence_final.csv"
  )) |>
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  rename(rmse_weighted = weighted_rmse_smooth) |>
  select(-rmse_extreme, -weighted_rmse_step) |>
  mutate(model = "persis")

rmses_linear <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee,
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "detrending/final/test_rmse_results.csv"
  )) |>
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  rename(
    region = x,
    rmse = rmse_all,
    rmse_weighted = weighted_rmse_smooth
  ) |>
  select(-rmse_extreme, -weighted_rmse_step) |>
  mutate(model = "linear") |>
  # Add horizons
  right_join(
    rmses_persis |> select(region, horizon),
    by = join_by(region)
  )

rmses_rf <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee, 
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "RMSE_results_2021_2024_RF/RF_rmse_results_standard_2021_2024.csv"
  )) |>
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  rename(rmse_weighted = weighted_rmse_smooth) |>
  select(
    -rmse_extreme,
    -weighted_rmse_step, 
    -num_features,
    -feature_names, 
    -r_squared
  ) |>
  mutate(model = "rf")

rmses_rf_weighted <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee, 
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "RMSE_results_2021_2024_RF/RF_rmse_results_weighted_2021_2024.csv"
  )) |>
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  rename(rmse_weighted = weighted_rmse_smooth) |>
  select(
    -rmse_extreme,
    -weighted_rmse_step, 
    -num_features,
    -feature_names, 
    -r_squared
  ) |>
  mutate(model = "rf weighted")

rmses_eesn <-
  read.csv(file = paste0(
    fp_cee, 
    fp_res_test_eesn,
    "final-rmses-chosen-by-all-data.csv"
  )) |> 
  filter(data == "testing") |>
  select(-X, -file, -(m:data), -rmse_extreme) |>
  rename(
    region = target_region,
    horizon = tau
  ) |> 
  mutate(model = "eesn")

rmses_eesn_weighted <-
  read.csv(file = paste0(
    fp_cee, 
    fp_res_test_eesn,
    "final-rmses-chosen-by-weighted.csv"
  )) |> 
  filter(data == "testing") |>
  select(-X, -file, -(m:data), -rmse_extreme) |>
  rename(
    region = target_region,
    horizon = tau
  ) |> 
  mutate(model = "eesn weighted")
```

Join RMSEs:

```{r}
rmses <-
  bind_rows(
    rmses_persis,
    rmses_linear,
    rmses_rf,
    rmses_rf_weighted,
    rmses_eesn,
    rmses_eesn_weighted
  ) |>
    select(model, everything()) |>
    arrange(model, region, horizon)
```

Compute RF and EESN RMSEs based on their predictions:

```{r}
rmses_models <-
  preds |>
  select(horizon, region, date, obs_detrended, pred_detrended_rf, pred_detrended_eesn) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = pred_detrended_rf:pred_detrended_eesn,
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "pred"
  ) |>
  na.omit() |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rmse = sqrt(sum((obs_detrended - pred)^2) / n()),
    .by = c(horizon, region, model)
  )
```

## R2

Load R2s:

```{r}
r2_rf <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee, 
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "RMSE_results_2021_2024_RF/RF_rmse_results_standard_2021_2024.csv"
  )) |>
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  rename(r2 = r_squared) |>
  select(region, horizon, r2) |> 
  mutate(model = "rf")
```

R2 computation check:

```{r}
r2_rf_calc <-
  preds |>
  summarise(
    r2_calc = 1 - (
      sum((obs_detrended - pred_detrended_rf)^2) / 
        sum((obs_detrended - mean(obs_detrended))^2)
    ),
    .by = c(horizon, region)
  )

full_join(r2_rf, r2_rf_calc, by = join_by(region, horizon)) |> 
  summarise(agree_or_disagree = if_else(
    sum(round(r2, 8) != round(r2_calc, 8)) == 0, 
    "all agree!", 
    "disagreements"
  ))
```

Compute R2 for EESN:

```{r}
r2_eesn <-
  preds |>
  summarise(
    r2 = 1 - (
      sum((obs_detrended - pred_detrended_eesn)^2) / 
        sum((obs_detrended - mean(obs_detrended))^2)
    ),
    .by = c(horizon, region)
  ) |> 
  mutate(model = "eesn")
```

Join R2s:

```{r}
r2 = bind_rows(r2_rf, r2_eesn)
```

## MSE Decomposition

Load MSE decomposition:

```{r}
mse_decomp_rf <-
    read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee, 
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "predictions_2021_2024_RF/MSE_DECOMP_RF.csv"
  )) |> 
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  mutate(model = "rf")

mse_decomp_eesn <-
    read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee, 
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "predictions_2021_2024_RF/MSE_DECOMP_EESN.csv"
  )) |>
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  mutate(model = "eesn")
```

Join MSE decomposition:

```{r}
mse_decomp <-
  bind_rows(
    mse_decomp_rf,
    mse_decomp_eesn
  )
```

## Bootstrap

Load bootstrap results: 

```{r}
boot_rf <-
    read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee,
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "predictions_2021_2024_RF/bootstrap_results_RF.csv"
  )) |> 
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  select(-x) |>
  mutate(model = "rf")

boot_eesn <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee,
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "predictions_2021_2024_RF/bootstrap_results_EESN.csv"
  )) |>
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  select(-x) |>
  mutate(model = "eesn")
```

Join bootstrap results:

```{r}
boot <-
  bind_rows(
    boot_rf,
    boot_eesn
  )
```

## All Metrics

Join all metrics:

```{r}
all_metrics <-
  full_join(rmses, r2, by = join_by(model, region, horizon)) |>
  left_join(mse_decomp, by = join_by(model, region, horizon)) |>
  left_join(boot, by = join_by(model, region, horizon))
```

## Bootstrap Results

```{r}
boot |>
  filter(model == "rf") |>
  select(-n, -model) |>
  rename(
    Region = region,
    Horizon = horizon,
    "\\shortstack{Mean MSE \\\\ Difference}" = mean_mse_diff,
    "\\shortstack{Confidence Interval \\\\ (Lower)}" = ci_lower,
    "\\shortstack{Confidence Interval \\\\ (Upper)}" = ci_upper,
    "\\shortstack{RF \\\\ Better}?" = rf_better,
    "\\shortstack{Climatology \\\\ Better?}" = climatology_better
  ) |>
  xtable(
    caption = "Bootstrap results for RF on test period (95\\% confidence levels)."
  ) |>
  print(
    booktabs = TRUE,   
    include.rownames = FALSE,
    sanitize.colnames.function = identity,
    caption.placement = "top",
    size = "\\scriptsize"
  )
```

```{r}
boot |>
  filter(model == "eesn") |>
  select(-n, -model) |>
  rename(
    Region = region,
    Horizon = horizon,
    "\\shortstack{Mean MSE \\\\ Difference}" = mean_mse_diff,
    "\\shortstack{Confidence Interval \\\\ (Lower)}" = ci_lower,
    "\\shortstack{Confidence Interval \\\\ (Upper)}" = ci_upper,
    "\\shortstack{EESN \\\\ Better}?" = rf_better,
    "\\shortstack{Climatology \\\\ Better?}" = climatology_better
  ) |>
  xtable(
    caption = "Bootstrap results for EESN on test period (95\\% confidence levels)."
  ) |>
  print(
    booktabs = TRUE,   
    include.rownames = FALSE,
    sanitize.colnames.function = identity,
    caption.placement = "top",
    size = "\\scriptsize"
  )
```

# Figures

## RMSEs (without persistence)

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 12
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

plot_rmses <-
  all_metrics |>
  filter(model != "persis", model != "eesn weighted", model != "rf weighted") |>
  select(model, region, horizon, rmse, rmse_weighted) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(rmse, rmse_weighted), names_to = "metric") |>
  mutate(
    model = fct_recode(
      model, 
      "Linear Model" = "linear",
      "Random Forest" = "rf",
      "EESN" = "eesn"
      ),
    metric = fct_recode(
      metric,
      "RMSE" = "rmse",
      "Weighted RMSE" = "rmse_weighted"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = fct_relevel(model, "Linear Model", "EESN", "Random Forest"),
    metric = fct_relevel(metric, "RMSE", "Weighted RMSE")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = horizon, y = value, group = model, color = model)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + 
  geom_point(size = 2.25) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ region, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "black", 
      met.brewer(name = "Egypt", n = 4, type = "discrete")[c(2,4)]
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  ) + 
  labs(x = "Horizon", y = NULL, color = NULL)

plot_rmses
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  'figs/RMSEs.png', 
  plot_rmses, 
  width = 12, 
  height = 8
)
```

## R2 and Mean MSE Difference with Confidence Intervals

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 12
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

plot_r2 <-
  all_metrics |>
  filter(model == "eesn" | model == "rf") |>
  select(model, region, horizon, r2) |>
  mutate(model = fct_recode(model, "Random Forest" = "rf", "EESN" = "eesn")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = horizon, y = r2, color = model)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) + 
  geom_point(size = 2.25) +
  facet_grid(. ~ region) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = met.brewer(name = "Egypt", n = 4, type = "discrete")[c(2,4)]
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "Horizon", y = "R2", color = NULL)

plot_mse_diff <-
  all_metrics |>
  filter(model == "eesn" | model == "rf") |>
  select(model, region, horizon, mean_mse_diff, ci_lower, ci_upper) |>
  mutate(model = fct_recode(model, "Random Forest" = "rf", "EESN" = "eesn")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = horizon, y = mean_mse_diff, color = model)) + 
  geom_point(size = 2.25, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) + 
  geom_errorbar(
    mapping = aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), 
    width = 0.25, 
    linewidth = 0.75,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  facet_grid(. ~ region) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = met.brewer(name = "Egypt", n = 4, type = "discrete")[c(2,4)]
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Horizon", y = "Mean MSE Difference", color = NULL)

plot_r2_and_mse_diff <-
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    plot_r2, plot_mse_diff, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.43, 0.57)
  )

plot_r2_and_mse_diff
```

## MSE Decomposition

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 12
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
plot_mse_decomp <-
  all_metrics |>
  filter(model == "eesn" | model == "rf") |>
  select(
    model, 
    region,
    horizon, 
    correlation_component, 
    conditional_bias, 
    unconditional_bias
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = correlation_component:unconditional_bias, 
    names_to = "metric"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = fct_recode(model, "Random Forest" = "rf", "EESN" = "eesn"),
    metric = fct_recode(
      metric, 
      "Unconditional Bias" = "unconditional_bias", 
      "Conditional Bias" = "conditional_bias", 
      "Imperfect Correlation" = "correlation_component"
    ),
    metric = fct_relevel(
      metric,
      "Unconditional Bias",
      "Conditional Bias",
      "Correlation Component"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = horizon, y = value, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(model ~ region) + 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = met.brewer(name = "Johnson", n = 6, type = "continuous")[c(6,4,5)]
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Horizon", y = "MSE", fill = NULL)

plot_mse_decomp
```

## Zscore Bin Plot (RF)

Create binned data:

```{r}
## Function to create seasons
seasons <- function(w){
  s <- rep('Winter', length(w))
  s[w < 49] <- 'Fall'
  s[w < 36] <- 'Summer'
  s[w < 23] <- 'Spring'
  s[w < 10] <- 'Winter'
  return(s)
}

## Function to bin data
bins <- function(x){
  b <- rep(8, length(x))
  b[x < 1.5] <- 7
  b[x < 1.0] <- 6
  b[x < 0.5] <- 5
  b[x < 0.0] <- 4
  b[x < -0.5] <- 3
  b[x < -1.0] <- 2
  b[x < -1.5] <- 1
  return(b)
}

## Bin Z_scores
binned_test_pred_obs <- 
  preds |> 
  mutate(season = seasons(week)) |> 
  mutate(bin = bins(z_score)) 

## Summarize by bin and season
bin_rmses <- 
  binned_test_pred_obs |> 
  mutate(
    resid_rf = pred_detrended_rf - obs_detrended,
    resid_eesn = pred_detrended_eesn - obs_detrended,
    error_rf = resid_rf^2,
    error_eesn = resid_eesn^2
  ) |> 
  summarize(
    rmse_rf = sqrt(mean(error_rf)),
    rmse_eesn = sqrt(mean(error_eesn)),
    .by = c(horizon, region, season, bin)
  )
```

Prepare options for plots:

```{r}
make_fullsize <- function() structure("", class = "fullsizebar")
color_min = floor(min(c(bin_rmses$rmse_eesn, bin_rmses$rmse_rf)))
color_max = ceiling(max(c(bin_rmses$rmse_eesn, bin_rmses$rmse_rf)))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_bins_rf <- 
  bin_rmses |> 
  filter(bin != 8) |> 
  mutate(
    season = factor(season, levels=c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = horizon, y = bin, fill = rmse_rf)) +
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = pals::parula(256), 
    limits = c(color_min, color_max)
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    season ~ region,
    scales = 'free',
    axes = 'all',
    labeller = label_wrap_gen(multi_line = FALSE)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1.5, by = 1, length.out = 7),
    labels = seq(-1.5, 1.5, by=0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(y = 'Z-score', x = "Horizon", fill = "RMSE") +
  #make_fullsize() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(        
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
  ) 
```

```{r}
  mutate(
```

```{r}
  )
```

## RMSEs

```{r}
all_metrics |>
  filter(model == "rf") |>
  select(region, horizon, rmse, rmse_weighted, r2) |>
  rename(
    Region = region,
    Horizon = horizon,
    RMSE = rmse,
    "RMSE weighted" = rmse_weighted,
    "$R^2$" = r2
  ) |>
  xtable(
    align = rep("c",6),
    caption = "RMSE, wRMSEm and $R^2$ values for RF forecasts (models were tuned using RMSE)."

  print(
    booktabs = TRUE,   
    include.rownames = FALSE,
    sanitize.colnames.function = identity,
    caption.placement = "top",
    size = "\\small"
  )
```
